title: Fort Smith Southside Southern Belles decorate yards for 4th of July to fundraise for Macy's Thanksgiving Parade - NewsBreak
text:
By Annie Glasco ,
9 hours ago
FORT SMITH, Ark. (KNWA/KFTA) — Every year, the Southside High School Senior Southern Belles work hard to raise funds for the opportunity to perform in the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade. This year, the team has already begun fundraising efforts in hopes to make it to the 100th year of the New York City celebration.
The once-in-a-lifetime opportunity allows the team to showcase their hard work on a national stage while honoring the community that supported them along the way.
This year, as a fundraising effort, the Senior Belles will place American Flags in the yards of supporters who made recent donations to celebrate America’s 250th birthday and the Fourth of July holiday.
“We are committed not only to performing at our best, but also to giving back through community service as a way to say thank you to the city we proudly call home,” the team’s website states .
Fort Smith Regional Art Museum unveils Our Common Ground The team will also donate 1% of their annual collections towards hygiene kits for students at both Fort Smith high schools.
“By dedicating a portion of these funds to hygiene kits for both Fort Smith high schools, these young women are showing that their desire is not only to shine on a national stage, but also to stand with their peers, meet real needs in their own hallways and prove that while we wear different school colors, we are one city, one community,” the website stated.
Donations can be made to the team or to individual dancers on the team’s website.
“I’m beyond excited and grateful for the opportunity not only to visit New York, but also to perform there,” Senior Belle Addelyn Armstrong said. “All of my hopes and dreams have been poured into my dancing, and I’m truly thrilled to experience the Big Apple and the incredible Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade with my best friends.”
